button.label: Selection
button.screentip: Apply the target font to math zones in the selected text or equation blocks.

button.label: Current slide
button.screentip: Apply the target font to every math zone on the current slide.

button.label: All slides
button.screentip: Apply the target font to every math zone in the active presentation.

comboBox.label: Font
comboBox.screentip: Select or type an installed OpenType Math font. Install optional fonts separately.

toggleButton.label: Auto format
toggleButton.screentip: Apply the math font when you leave text editing, move to a slide, or select a shape.

button.label: Restore Cambria
button.screentip: Restore all equation fonts to Cambria Math and turn Auto format off.
